Author: Deuflhard
Description: ETK 854 ActiveHybrid 40e (B58) - P2 plug-in hybrid in the style of current premium six-cylinder plug-in hybrids. 3.0 L inline-six turbo gasoline engine (220 kW / 447 Nm, B58 calibration) + K0 disconnect clutch + 83 kW / 265 Nm P2 e-machine ahead of the torque converter, 8-speed automatic, 2.81 rear axle ratio, rear-wheel drive. 13.5 kWh battery. System output 303 kW (412 PS); the VCU caps the combined input torque at 680 Nm. Sailing, recuperation and all-electric pull-away. Delivered without the factory 250 km/h top-speed limiter (top speed limited by the powertrain).
